description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseTool' for tools, including methods for parsing parameters, executing, handling partial messages, and utility functions for streaming XML/JSON content. It also defines related interfaces and types for tool callbacks and parameter extraction.
external_methods: imported types: ToolName, ToolProtocol, ToolUse, HandleError, PushToolResult, RemoveClosingTag, AskApproval, NativeToolArgs

classes.name: BaseTool
classes.description: An abstract class providing a standardized architecture for tools, including parameter parsing, execution, partial message handling, and utility functions for streaming content.

methods.name: parseLegacy
methods.description: Abstract method to convert XML/legacy string parameters into typed parameters for the specific tool.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the core logic of the tool with typed parameters.

methods.name: handlePartial
methods.description: Optional method to handle streaming partial messages; default implementation does nothing.

methods.name: removeClosingTag
methods.description: Utility to remove partial closing XML tags from streamed content.

methods.name: hasPathStabilized
methods.description: Checks if a streaming path parameter has stabilized across partial messages.

methods.name: resetPartialState
methods.description: Resets internal state tracking for partial message handling.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Main entry point for tool execution, managing partial messages, parameter parsing, and invoking core execution.
